concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-paypal-disputes]] - PayPal-specific Braintree Control Panel dispute route covering linked-account setup, Retrieval/Claim/Chargeback roles, reply-by cutoff, fee boundary, customer-resolution-first guidance and status interpretation; not general Braintree dispute/API behavior
warnings: Keep PayPal's stages, labels, fees, setup and cross-platform behavior distinct from general Braintree credit-card disputes and server-SDK dispute operations.
Preserve the reply-by cutoff and configured-time-zone qualification.
Preserve the separate credit-card-dispute workflow boundary and do not imply that every Braintree dispute can be managed in the Control Panel.
Do not infer current product support or merchant enablement from the immutable 2026-09-16 snapshot.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-paypal-disputes]] - PayPal-specific Control Panel dispute management with full-integration and linked-account prerequisites, Add/Edit Processing Options permission, stage and deadline handling, retrieval actions, evidence routes and a separate credit-card-dispute workflow boundary
warnings: This route is specific to PayPal disputes and does not establish the Control Panel workflow for credit-card or other payment-method disputes.
Retain the account-linking, enablement and role-permission prerequisites when describing Control Panel availability.
Do not generalize Control Panel actions into server-side API or SDK capabilities.
